branches.B_rs: diagnostic: B through the SAME 30->20->30 + HML263 encode/decode + projection path (no model); does not replace B
branches.C: CondMDI R1 left arm, projected on Action 172..199 only
branches.W129_C: historical MotionBricks C, reference only (frozen numbers; not rerun)

case_rule.A: all gates pass AND QA1-QA6 pass: credible visual/semantic improvement vs BOTH A and B without source-intent loss (visual evidence = agent-only blinded stills; human native-rate review NOT RUN)
case_rule.B: real model, honest partial conditioning and a safe separate Blender Action are demonstrated (all gates pass) but any quality criterion QA1-QA6 fails (no demonstrated superiority)
case_rule.C: the real model ran but a representation/clock/Action/constraint gate (G1, G2, G4, G5, G7) fails or the projection is unsafe
case_rule.D: declared safety/integrity falsification: the masked-input leak control R3 is not bitwise equal to R1 (input-leak/contract failure), a negative control does not fail closed, the sample is not the pinned real model, or an instrument changed after this declaration
case_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: a prerequisite (rights, checkpoint identity, authentic S1/W126/W129 baselines, runtime, Blender, mask semantics, honest mapping, bounded 20<->30 conversion) is missing before primary inference

config.leak_control: R3 = UNKNOWN rig channels ['upperarm_r', 'lowerarm_r', 'hand_l', 'hand_r', 'foot_l', 'foot_r', 'neck_01', 'neck_02'] randomly rotated (seed 131) AND every masked input feature replaced by seeded noise (seed 131); output must be bitwise equal to R1
config.no_tuning: one model, one episode, one text, one mask, one sampler, one seed; no prompt/seed/window/mask/guidance sweep, no post-hoc smoothing
config.rerun: R2 = exact rerun in a new process (determinism only)
config.text: a person stands in place and presses both arms straight up overhead

gates.G0: preflight OK_PENDING_IDENTITY + identity: HF model.safetensors bitwise = official random_joints model_avg; LFS hashes
gates.G1: representation controls (controls.json G1_pass): FK parity <= 1e-5 m; arm-direction round trip <= 1e-3 deg; projection identity <= 1e-6; B_rs vs B <= 1e-6; official encoder/abs/decoder parity <= 1e-4; synthetic static/rotated/asymmetric/parent-child controls; UNKNOWN rig perturbation leaves every observed feature bitwise equal
gates.G2: clock: 160 samples x 1/20 s = 240 x 1/30 s; interior samples 114..132 only; frames 172..199 reconstructed from samples 114..132 on the original timestamps; scene 30 fps, keys 1..240 unchanged
gates.G3: authentic inference: pinned weights (hash-checked in the runner), official CondMDIPipeline._sample, mask validated (no UNKNOWN observed, left arm observed on both sides, not in the interior); R2 bitwise = R1; R3 (leak control) bitwise = R1
gates.G4: C (and B_rs) separate .blend + separately named Action; fresh-process readback: 1 Action, 32 CONSTANT F-curves keyed 1..240, 30 fps, scene 1..240; changed keys only upperarm_l/lowerarm_l in 172..199; every non-left-arm bone world point and the object matrix bit-equal on every integer frame and subframe; left arm bit-equal outside 172..199; baseline/lineage files unchanged
gates.G5: hard pin: Action 132..140 bit-equal C vs A; C composed onto the W126V-accepted .blend keeps every pin-frame residual equal to W126V's and <= 1e-6 m (authoritative tolerance 1 mm)
gates.G7: native-rate synchronized video: 240 frames written and decoded at 30.000 fps

quality_criteria.QA1: C has 0 ARM-LOCAL wrist reversal flicks (clavicle_l frame) in steps 171->172 .. 199->200 (consecutive steps both > 20 mm with negative dot)
quality_criteria.QA2: C ARM-LOCAL boundary C0 entry/exit wrist steps each <= 2 x B's + 10 mm
quality_criteria.QA3: C has no near-straight (> 175 deg) interior frame, no bend-direction flip, no frame bending against the A hinge reference
quality_criteria.QA4: source fidelity: C mean interior WORLD wrist deviation from A <= 1.25 x B's + 25 mm
quality_criteria.QA5: overhead-press intent (no swing): over Action 172..199, C's wrist height above the left shoulder (world z) never falls more than 50 mm below the lower of its values at Action 171 and 200
quality_criteria.QA6: blinded agent visual review: C judged most natural (V2), not named for a flick (V1) or wrong elbow (V3), not least faithful (V4), and read as an upward press (V6 = yes)

representation.declared_coupling: HML263 positions are pelvis-relative: the left elbow/wrist conditioning is anchored on the rigid rest upper torso (PROXY) carried by the driven spine_01; the upper-spine/clavicle bending is UNKNOWN and is the rig's rest. Disclosed, not hidden.
representation.encoder: official HumanML3D recipe (uniform skeleton with 000021 lengths, canonical frame-0, smoothed official root heading, root-relative positions); the floor deviates: min over ankles minus c_ankle
representation.mask: absolute-space: root yaw + height; ric positions of every non-UNKNOWN joint at all 160 samples; left elbow/wrist only outside samples 114..132; no rotation, velocity, contact or root-xz feature
representation.projection: generated left_shoulder->elbow and elbow->wrist directions (canonical -> undo frame-0 facing -> A^T) -> minimal swing from the frozen W129 B orientation (B supplies twist) -> upperarm_l, then lowerarm_l; per sample, then 20->30 slerp

source.edit_domain: upperarm_l / lowerarm_l local quaternion keys at Action 172..199 = SOURCE 250..277
source.episode: S1 (CC BY-SA 4.0 double kettlebell strict press, side view)

protected_pin.state: accepted in W126 then REVERTED (no active pin at the head)

stop_conditions: leak control R3 not bitwise equal -> STOP (D, input-leak/contract failure)
projection would touch any non-left-arm channel or frame outside 172..199 -> refuse (C)
no retiming / window shift / tuning after output

time_map.reconstruction: frame f <- model position s=2(f-1)/3: exact sample when integral, else slerp of the per-sample left-arm basis between samples floor(s), floor(s)+1 (weights 1/3, 2/3); only Action 172..199 (s=114..132) are written; Action 240 (s=159.33) is beyond the last sample and never reconstructed
time_map.rule: Action frame f at t=(f-1)/30 s on [0, 8.0); model sample k at t=k/20 s; 240 frames <-> 160 samples; even k = exact frame 1+1.5k; odd k = half-frame, every keyed channel SO(3)-slerped at 0.5 (INTERPOLATED hypothesis)

visual_protocol: panels X/Y/Z = random permutation of A/B/C sealed in blind_key_SEALED.json; the agent answers from blinded stills BEFORE reading the key; AGENT-ONLY, not human; native-rate perceptual review NOT RUN (cannot be done by the agent)

visual_questions.V1: Which panel(s) show a visible unnatural one-frame flick/teleport/reversal of the left arm (around Action 171-175)?
visual_questions.V2: Which panel's left-arm motion through the interior looks most natural and temporally coherent?
visual_questions.V3: Which panel(s) show an anatomically wrong elbow (hyperextension, flip) or limb-length artefact?
visual_questions.V4: Rank the panels by agreement with the source video's visible left-arm pose and timing (rack -> press); which is least faithful?
visual_questions.V5: Is any boundary discontinuity visible at 171/172 or 199/200 in any panel?
visual_questions.V6: For each panel: does the interior read as an upward overhead press (yes) or as a swing / detour / other motion (no)?
